notes: §1985:XII.2.4 GR6: 'the sequence of text words in the library text, if any, and in pseudo-text-1 is determined by the rules for reference format'; comment lines and blank lines are ignored for matching. Library text is converted by the same fixed-form walker as source text, so below 2002 a *> in it is a text-word (§1985:III) exactly as one in pseudo-text-1 is, and COPY ... REPLACING matches and removes it (kb/Work PB5470): the witness removes the text-words *> "Z" from library text and matches the four text-words DISPLAY "1" *> J.

But 1985 copies comment and blank lines of library text and pseudo-text-2 'into the resultant source program unchanged'; 2023 discards them and §2023:7.2.3.4 GR13 says replacement 'shall not introduce ... a comment, or a blank line'.
